ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 residential single-unit
(detached house) district symbols as shown on Map No. 12-H

in the area bounded by:

A line 94.50 feet south of and parallel to West 49 Street; South Damen Avenue; a line
214.50 feet south of and parallel to West 49" Street; the public alley next west of and
parallel to South Damen Avenue.

To those of a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 4910-20 S. Damen Avenue, Chicago, IL
